race.comment: MAYBE (7) is the horse to beat after a narrow third at Longreach, where she was beaten just over half a length despite jumping awkwardly and racing wide throughout. That was backed by a sound CL5 placing at Isisford. Can get the job done this time. DESIROUS (6) is fresher than most and brings a solid 1000m record. Will find this easier and gets a good chance to make a bright start for the new stable. EGYPTIAN LASS (8) commands respect after winning by 2.5L here, with the winning rider back and a 3kg claim to offset the weight. VALIANT JOAN (11) has been highly consistent, was only beaten just over half a length at Longreach, and has won at this track, though the wide draw and the sharper 1000m temper the confidence.
